highlights: Baseus 120W GaN2 Pro Quick Charger 2C+U CCGAN-K01 Triple Fast Wall Charger

The Baseus wall adapter has a current intensity of 120 watts, which is high power for charging various devices such as mobile phones, tablets, laptops, etc., and can charge 60% of your phone's battery in a short period of half an hour.
It supports various fast charging protocols including SCP, FCP, PPS, PD3.0, PD2.0, QC3.0, QC2.0, SCP.
But note that having a cable that has fast charging capabilities is also very effective in fast charging.
The gallium nitride technology used in this ultra-fast wall charger is a chemical compound with semiconductor properties that offers better power and temperature efficiency in a small area.
Among the characteristics of this material are high bandwidth, high thermal conductivity, significant thermal resistance, radiation resistance, acid resistance, and high strength and rigidity.
Has two Type-C ports  and one USB port
Ultra-fast charging with 120 watts of power
Can be used for all types of phones, tablets, power banks, laptops and other devices.
Folding pins for easier carrying and storage
